exact_request.text: Compact fantasy tactical game sound, dry close recording, clear at low volume, controlled transients and soft high frequencies, centered mono-compatible, no speech, no background music, no environmental ambience, no long reverb. Keep instrument gestures brief when musically themed. Precise dagger puncture with a compact leather-like bite and dark magical tick, no exaggerated gore. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.
